build_HifiGANVocoder: build a HifiGAN vocoder from a checkpoint and config to synthesize speech from discrete audio codes
run_HifiGANVocoder_forward: run the HifiGAN vocoder forward pass with audio codes, speaker ID, and style ID to generate waveform
create_CodeGenerator: create a CodeGenerator model from config with optional speaker, style, f0, and duration prediction support
test_ResBlock: test the ResBlock convolutional residual module with configurable kernel sizes and dilation rates for HiFi-GAN
review_VariancePredictor: review the VariancePredictor module for predicting duration from encoded speech representations
